register.name: Dual-tranche dollar bonds
register.detail: Ministry of Finance · September 2026 · $1bn over 5 years at 55bps over US Treasuries · $2bn over 10 years at 65bps over US Treasuries
register.note: Order book peaked at $7.7 billion, 2.5 times oversubscribed
register.text: Conventional bonds of the State of Qatar, sold by the Ministry of Finance to investors across Asia, Europe, the Middle East and the United States. Their proceeds fund the state budget as a whole, whose expected deficit for 2026 is to be covered through local and external debt instruments, and are not earmarked to any one of the seven standards.
by: Ministry of Finance, State of Qatar

register.name: First sovereign green bonds
register.detail: Ministry of Finance · issued May 2024 · $1bn over 5 years (XS2822506759) and $1.5bn over 10 years (XS2822506833) · 5.7 times oversubscribed · fully allocated · impact report February 2026
register.note: $879M to sustainable water and wastewater management, $1bn to clean transportation and $621M to climate change adaptation
register.text: Qatar’s first green bonds, issued under its Sovereign Green Financing Framework, whose proceeds went to projects of the Public Works Authority (Ashghal). They finance sewage treatment, recycled water and stormwater drainage, serving the water and shelter standards, and climate adaptation works whose share attributed to the bonds benefits a population of 203,399.
by: Ministry of Finance, State of Qatar
